rights_basis: Faithful bounded reading transcription of original-language liturgical text from Missale Chaldaicum iuxta ritum Ecclesiae nationis Maronitarum (Rome Medici, 1594) — Anaphora of the Twelve Apostles Core, whose United States copyright term has expired by publication date (1594 (Syriac title 1592)). Derived directly from tracked public-domain facsimile artifact.maronite-church.qurbono.1594-rome-medici.ia-scan-pdf-dbab3b5b without modern translation or editorial reconstruction. text: ܒܝܘܡܐ ܗܘ ܕܩܕܡ ܚܫܐ ܕܝܠܗ ܢܣܒ ܠܠܚܡܐ ܒܐܝܕܘܗܝ ܩܕܝܫܬܐ ܘܐܪܝܡ ܥܝܢܘܗܝ ܠܘܬܟ ܐܠܗܐ ܐܒܘܗܝ ܐܚܝܕ ܟܠ ܘܐܘܕܝ ܠܟ ܘܒܪܟ ܘܩܨܐ ܘܝܗܒ ܠܬܠܡܝܕܘܗܝ ܟܕ ܐܡܪ ܣܒܘ ܐܟܘܠܘ ܡܢܗ ܟܠܟܘܢ ܗܢܐ ܕܝܢ ܐܝܬܘܗܝ ܦܓܪܐ ܕܝܠܝ
